phase: AnyTour Design System 1.0 and site-wide visual unification are now priority #1. Search remains the strongest reference surface, but the whole public site is explicitly not rated 9/10 until cross-page visual consistency is proven.

target.rule: Do not raise site-wide scores from CI/tooling alone; require production visual evidence across public pages and required viewports.

current_task.progress: Owner identified a material site-wide defect: search and other public pages use visibly different headers/composition/spacing and the migrated pages do not feel like one coherent product. Previous search-only 9.0 scorecard must not be used as a whole-site visual score.
current_task.next_action: Audit production /, /poisk-turov/, /hot/, /contacts/, /how-to-buy/, /rb/, /country/ and representative country pages at 375/430/768/1024/1440; create/maintain a site-wide scorecard; then implement shared design tokens/primitives, one header/navigation and one footer before migrating weak pages onto the shared shell. Continue through multiple safe pages/tasks per run rather than stopping after one cosmetic fix.

work_order: site-wide quality scorecard based on actual public pages
shared AnyTour design tokens and primitives
single shared footer with existing verified destinations
migrate /hot/, /country/ + country pages, /contacts/, /how-to-buy/, /rb/ to shared shell
align /poisk-turov/ shell without regressing mature search UX
after unification, deepen discovery/content/SEO modules without duplicating search business logic

deferred.reason: Requires deliberate publication contract and reviewed content.
Legacy legal/payment content/requisites are not reconciled.
Separate DB/platform architecture; do not auto-merge during visual-unification work.

continuation_policy.priority: production_broken > lead_loss > incorrect_data > sitewide_visual_incoherence_and_poor_ux > responsive_stability > content_seo > cosmetic_refactor
continuation_policy.on_no_traffic: ignore_as expected and continue visual/product development
